title: The Meridian Affair
synopsis: The CEO of Meridian Tech has been found dead in his penthouse office, hours before a landmark IPO. Forty million dollars of investor funds have vanished. Everyone around the table had motive. Only one of you did it.

characters.name: Dana Reeves
characters.motive: Victor discovered Dana had been siphoning funds into a secret account in Cyprus for 18 months. A private audit was scheduled for Monday.
characters.alibi: Claims to have been on a 9pm call with the Singapore office. Phone records show the call lasted 4 minutes, not the 90 minutes claimed.
secrets: The Cyprus account holds ₪2.3M taken from R&D budgets
Dana forged Victor's signature on three wire transfers
Dana has a second phone registered under a fake name
characters.instructions: You are nervous but hiding it well. Deflect questions about the Singapore call. Mention repeatedly how much you trusted Victor.

characters.name: Eli Stern
characters.motive: Victor was selling the company's core algorithm patent to a Chinese competitor — Eli's life's work — without his knowledge or consent.
characters.alibi: Was in the server room at the time, visible on CCTV. Solid alibi.
secrets: Eli knew about the patent sale three weeks ago
Eli tried to bribe the acquirer to walk away
Eli copied the full codebase to a personal drive last Tuesday
characters.instructions: You have a real alibi and you know it. Be calm, almost too calm. Drop hints that you knew something was very wrong with the IPO.

characters.name: Sophie Katz
characters.motive: Victor had discovered Sophie was leaking deal terms to a rival firm in exchange for a future partnership offer.
characters.alibi: Claims to have been at a charity gala. Two witnesses confirm she was there — but she left early, at 9:30pm.
secrets: Sophie received ₪80,000 in a personal account from the rival firm
She drafted a document that would have implicated herself if signed
She destroyed a USB drive the morning after Victor's death
characters.instructions: You are polished and in control. Use legal language to deflect. Never say anything that commits you to a timeline.

characters.name: Marco Vidal
characters.motive: Victor promised Marco a VP promotion for two years. The IPO prospectus, which Marco proofread, listed his title as 'Senior Coordinator' permanently.
characters.alibi: Was in the building late, claims he was preparing IPO materials. The security log shows he badged into the executive floor at 9:47pm.
secrets: Marco has a copy of Victor's personal calendar
Marco overheard the conversation between Victor and Dana two weeks ago
Marco was approached by a journalist before Victor died
characters.instructions: You are eager to help with the investigation. You know more than you let on. Drop breadcrumbs. You didn't kill anyone but you're terrified of what you might have caused.

characters.name: Rachel Bloom
characters.motive: Victor had told Rachel privately the IPO would be delayed. She had already committed her fund's capital and would face personal ruin if the deal collapsed.
characters.alibi: Was at a dinner with three other investors at a restaurant downtown. Left at 10:15pm.
secrets: Rachel knew the IPO numbers were inflated
She transferred ₪4M of investor capital against fund rules
She has a personal relationship with a member of the board
characters.instructions: You are aggressive and impatient. Money is the only language you speak. Push other players to account for their whereabouts.

characters.name: Thomas Vance
characters.motive: Victor was about to expose Thomas for taking kickbacks from a vendor for the past three years.
characters.alibi: No alibi. Claims he was home alone. No digital footprint after 8pm.
secrets: Thomas received ₪600,000 in vendor kickbacks over three years
Victor sent Thomas a message at 9:12pm — Thomas never replied
Thomas hired a private investigator to follow Victor six months ago
characters.instructions: You are old-money composed. Never raise your voice. When cornered, pivot to procedure and process. You are the murderer. Do not confess unless the evidence is ironclad.

characters.name: Noa Ben-David
characters.motive: Victor was planning to fire Noa and replace her with a younger hire, blaming her for a damaging press leak last quarter.
characters.alibi: Was at a media event until 11pm. Multiple photographers confirm.
secrets: Noa was the source of the press leak — it was intentional
She was offered a job at the rival firm three days ago
She has a threatening voicemail from Victor on her phone
characters.instructions: You are media-trained and charming. Spin everything. Your instinct is to control the narrative. You are secretly relieved Victor is dead.

characters.name: Jake Peretz
characters.motive: Victor had discovered Jake had fabricated ₪8M in pipeline to inflate the IPO valuation. Criminal fraud charges were possible.
characters.alibi: Was on a flight back from London, landed at 10:40pm. Confirmed by airline records.
secrets: The pipeline fabrication was done with CFO Dana's knowledge
Jake met with Victor two days before his death
Jake has a burner phone with deleted messages
characters.instructions: You are confident and charming. Use humor to deflect. You know about the Cyprus account — use that as a weapon if you feel cornered.

screenEvent.title: BREAKING: Meridian Tech CEO Found Dead
screenEvent.body: Victor Harel, 54, CEO of Meridian Technologies, was discovered unresponsive in his 32nd-floor office at 11:45pm last night. An IPO valuation of ₪400 million was set for 9am this morning. All senior executives have been asked to remain on site pending investigation. This broadcast is being monitored.

screenEvent.title: LEAKED: Internal Email Chain
screenEvent.body: An anonymous source has forwarded the following email chain to our newsroom. FROM: v.harel@meridian.com TO: t.vance@meridian.com — 'Thomas, this cannot continue. I know about the Arkana payments. Meet me tonight at 9pm or I go to the board in the morning. — V'

buzzEvents.message: The email is real. You never showed up at 9pm. You went to the office instead. Stay calm — nobody can prove what happened after you arrived.
You saw this email two days ago. Victor showed you as leverage against Thomas. You weren't the only target.

screenEvent.title: CCTV: Executive Floor, 9:53pm
screenEvent.body: Security footage from the 32nd floor shows an unidentified figure in a dark coat entering the stairwell at 9:53pm — seven minutes after Thomas Vance's building access log shows him badging in at street level. The elevator camera malfunctioned between 9:48pm and 10:14pm. Maintenance records show no prior fault.

callEvent.script: You answer the phone. A distorted voice speaks: 'You were seen leaving the building at 10:22pm. The CCTV hard drive was wiped remotely from inside the server room. Someone is covering for you. Or covering themselves. Either way — the morning audit will find the Arkana account. You have until dessert to decide who you're protecting.' The line goes dead.

screenEvent.title: FORENSICS: Preliminary Cause of Death
screenEvent.body: Preliminary forensic analysis indicates Victor Harel died from acute cardiac event consistent with a rapidly acting vasodilator compound. No signs of struggle. Time of death estimated between 9:45pm and 10:15pm. A prescription bottle matching the compound was found in a desk drawer — prescribed to a Meridian employee. Name redacted pending notification.

buzzEvents.message: The prescription is yours. You filled it three weeks ago and left it in Victor's office during a meeting. You didn't plan this. You carried it with you that night because you were afraid. You used it when he threatened to call the police on the spot.
You know the prescription is not yours. But you also know whose name is on it. Do you use this information now, or wait?

screenEvent.title: INVESTIGATION UPDATE
screenEvent.body: Investigators have narrowed their focus. All present are asked to formally state their theory of events. Each person at the table must name one suspect and provide their reasoning. The investigation will proceed based on the collective accusation.

screenEvent.title: THE MERIDIAN VERDICT
screenEvent.body: Based on the evidence presented, investigators have concluded the following...

resolution.explanation: Thomas Vance killed Victor Harel to prevent exposure of three years of vendor kickbacks worth ₪600,000. He arrived at the building at 9:48pm, took the stairs to avoid elevator cameras he knew were monitored, and administered a vasodilator compound from his own prescription during what appeared to be a confrontation. He remotely wiped the elevator CCTV from a terminal he had access to as a board member. He had the motive, the access, and the means.
resolution.revealScript: Thomas Vance. Board member. Eleven years of service. The man who seconded every motion and seconded every expense. The prescription was filled under his name on April 3rd — three weeks before Victor's death. The Arkana account received its final payment on the same day. Victor gave him an ultimatum at 9pm. Thomas chose a different kind of resolution. The IPO would have buried him. Victor dying preserved a lie — for one more night.
